body:
Model-level CG↔DG switching (#2605): a tendency written once — an element-local
weak form plus one completion call — runs on both discretizations, selected by
the space.

- **CG/DG as discretization alternatives.** A spectral-element grid stores its
  Galerkin discretization as the singleton `Grids.CG()` (default) or
  `Grids.DG()`, constructed with `discretization = Grids.DG()` and read back with `Grids.discretization(grid)` / `Spaces.discretization(space)` for
  dispatch.
- `Operators.tendency_completion(dydt; numflux, boundary_numflux = nothing)` built from the space and dispatched on `Spaces.discretization`: a DSS buffer
  on `CG()`, interface/boundary numerical fluxes on `DG()`. `numflux` is unused
  on CG, so models pass it unconditionally.
- `Operators.complete_tendency!(completion, dydt, args...)` — `weighted_dss!`
  on CG; on DG the mass-weighted surface term (`*= WJ` → interface/boundary
  flux → `/= WJ`).
- Remove allocations in DG Laplacian
- The Bickley-jet CG/DG smoke test runs both discretizations.

`vector_laplacian` still errors on DG (needs grad-div/curl-curl lifting), so
the switch covers flux-form tendencies for now.

Co-produced with Claude
title: Add model-level CG↔DG switching via tendency completions

body:
This PR adds the functionality to do vertical interpolation for a multiple column space to get back an array whose size is the number of columns by the number of vertical levels. Horizontal interpolation is not supported for this space.

I asked a LLM to implement this.
title: Add remapping for multiple column space
